query_ground_truth.workflow_task: As our sales operations lead, I need to clean up obsolete custom tracking properties in our HubSpot CRM and ensure we retain a record of the migration details by drafting an email to the revenue team with the confirmation details. Please check which properties need archiving, process the removal of the outdated custom property by name, and prepare a draft email outlining the changes made for review before we send it out.
query_ground_truth.query: Archive the obsolete custom property 'legacy_tier_score' under the contact object type in HubSpot CRM
query_ground_truth.rationale: Directly targets the HubSpot CRM property archiving tool to remove the specified custom property by its object type and name.

request.query: Archive the obsolete custom property 'legacy_tier_score' under the contact object type in HubSpot CRM

results.use_case: Archive the obsolete custom property 'legacy_tier_score' under the contact object type in HubSpot CRM
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if internal property name unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate deal properties using HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE (map display labels to internal names before making changes).
[Optional (if risk of changing the wrong field)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch the property definition using HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME (confirm current label, type, and settings).
[Required] [Step]: Update the property definition using HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CRM_PROPERTY (apply the new label and any other supported definition attributes).
[Required (after explicit confirmation)] [Step]: Archive the deprecated property using HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_PROPERTY_BY_OBJECT_TYPE_AND_NAME (remove the unused field).
[Optional (if archiving many properties)] [Fallback]: Archive in bulk using HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_BATCH_OF_PROPERTIES (reduce repetitive single-property archive calls).
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CRM_PROPERTY] Only certain property-definition fields are editable; unsupported attribute updates will fail and require trimming the request.
[HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CRM_PROPERTY] Updates the property definition only; it does not change existing deal record values that already use the property.
[HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_PROPERTY_BY_OBJECT_TYPE_AND_NAME] Archiving is effectively irreversible for many workflows—verify the object type and internal property name first.
[HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE] Display labels can be non-unique; select fields by internal name from the listing.

HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CRM_PROPERTY.description: Updates attributes of an existing HubSpot CRM property, identified by its `objectType` and `propertyName`; only provided fields are modified, and changing a property's `type` can cause data loss if incompatible with existing data.

type.description: New data type for the property. Modifying the `type` of an existing property with data can cause data loss; use with caution.

label.description: New human-readable label for the property, displayed in the HubSpot UI.

hidden.description: If true, hides the property in the HubSpot UI, making it not generally visible or usable in standard interfaces.

label.description: User-friendly label displayed in the HubSpot UI for this option (e.g., 'High Priority').

value.description: Internal, machine-readable value for this option (e.g., 'high_priority'), used when programmatically setting the property's value via API.

hidden.description: If true, this option is hidden in HubSpot selection UIs.

description.description: Optional detailed description for this option, providing additional context in HubSpot.

displayOrder.description: Sort order for this option relative to others. Lower positive integers display first; -1 typically places it after positively ordered options.

items.description: Defines a single option for an enumeration-type property.

options.description: List of new option definitions if property `type` is 'enumeration'; supplying a new list overwrites existing options.

fieldType.description: New field type controlling how the property is displayed and interacted with in the HubSpot UI.

formField.description: If true, allows this property to be included as a field in HubSpot forms and available in the form editor.

groupName.description: New internal name of the property group for this property; groups help organize properties in the HubSpot UI.

objectType.description: Type of CRM object for which the property is being updated; this determines its context.

description.description: New description for the property, displayed as help text in the HubSpot UI.

displayOrder.description: New display order for the property within its group. Lower positive integers appear first; -1 typically places it after positively numbered properties.

propertyName.description: Internal name of the property to update (case-sensitive); must correspond to an existing property for the specified `objectType`.

calculationFormula.description: New formula if `fieldType` is 'calculation_equation'; defines how its value is auto-computed. Ensure valid HubSpot calculation syntax.

HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_PROPERTY_BY_OBJECT_TYPE_.description: Archives a specified CRM property by its object type and name, moving it to the recycling bin; note that some default HubSpot properties cannot be archived.

objectType.description: The case-sensitive type of CRM object (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') for which the property is being archived; must match an existing object type.

propertyName.description: The case-sensitive internal name of the property to archive (e.g., 'custom_field_1', 'annual_revenue').

HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME.description: Reads a specific CRM property definition for a given HubSpot object type by its internal name.

archived.description: If true, retrieves an archived property definition; retrieves active property definitions by default.

objectType.description: Specifies the CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'deals') for which the property is retrieved.

properties.description: Optional comma-separated list of additional property attributes to return; consult HubSpot API documentation for available attributes and format.

propertyName.description: The internal, unique name of the property to retrieve (e.g., 'firstname', 'dealname').
